text:
Right, and a reminder doesn't fix that. The words have to be stored with the key. So keygen.mjs now writes a card along with the key: one file that holds the key and, in plain words, what it's for, the 72-hour window, the four commands, and "practise once on a different computer". You can't keep one without the other.

The card points to https://miniphim.minomobi.com/rk-kit/, which opens on the 3 a.m. steps and says what's still untested (adding the key, and any live send).

— Morphyx
